ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $BC=20$, points $B_1$, $B_2$, $B_3$, $B_4$ and points $C_1$, $C_2$, $C_3$, $C_4$ are the quintisection points of $AB$, $AC$ respectively. What is the value of $B_1C_1+B_2C_2+B_3C_3+B_4C_4$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\[ \text{Solution:} \quad \because \frac{AB_4}{AB} = \frac{AC_4}{AC} = \frac{4}{5}, \]
\[ \angle A = \angle A, \]
\[ \therefore \triangle AB_4C_4 \sim \triangle ABC, \]
\[ \therefore \frac{B_4C_4}{BC} = \frac{AB_4}{AB} = \frac{4}{5}, \]
\[ \therefore B_4C_4 = \frac{4}{5}BC = \frac{4}{5} \times 20 = 16, \]
Similarly, $B_1C_1 = 4$,
\[ B_2C_2 = 8, \]
\[ B_3C_3 = 12, \]
\[ \therefore B_1C_1 + B_2C_2 + B_3C_3 + B_4C_4 = \boxed{40}. \]
